name: Account main order
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Account main order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Legacy customer-account theme surface. Shopify owns authentication, account data and native form processing; current customer accounts are managed outside the theme. Tracking links require merchant configuration or native fulfillment data.

settings.label: Layout style
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for layout style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Back link label
settings.how: Enter the back link label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Orders page URL
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Show tracking button
settings.how: Turn on “Show tracking button” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Tracking button label
